description: The file defines an internal struct 'ValueStopwatch' that provides high-performance, non-allocating timing capabilities for measuring durations, including start, stop, reset, and elapsed time calculations. It uses system diagnostics and stopwatch hardware counters internally.

methods.name: StartNew
methods.description: Creates and starts a new stopwatch, optionally with an initial elapsed TimeSpan.

methods.name: FromTimestamp
methods.description: Creates a ValueStopwatch instance with specified start and end timestamps, representing a stopped state.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Stops the stopwatch and resets elapsed time to zero.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the stopwatch and records the elapsed time.

methods.name: GetTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the current system timestamp from hardware counters.

methods.name: GetRawTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the internal raw timestamp value.
